ModMetaData.name: Fullzoon's Cookies Renew
ModMetaData.author: Fullzoon - 1.6 port: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
A wheat crop and five biscuits baked from it, at either vanilla stove.
- Egg biscuit - wheat grain and an egg - Chocolate chip cookie - wheat grain, chocolate, milk - Butter cookie - wheat grain and milk - Berry biscuit - wheat grain and berries - Insect jelly biscuit - wheat grain and insect jelly
Each one comes in a batch of five, and every recipe also has an x5 and an x10 form, so filling a stockpile does not mean queueing fifteen bills. Biscuits are gluttonous snacks in the mould of vanilla chocolate: almost no nutrition, never eaten as a meal, and worth joy and a mood memory when a colonist eats one for pleasure. The insect jelly biscuit is the best of them, which is a strange thing to be able to say.
The wheat sows on ordinary soil or in hydroponics, grows in 4.5 days and yields six grain. The grain keeps for forty days and is good for nothing but baking.
No DLC required. No assembly, no framework, no dependency. English, French, and Fullzoon's own Chinese.
WHAT THE PORT FIXED
Two of these were live faults, not version drift.
The mod redefined PlantBase - the abstract def every plant in RimWorld inherits from - under that exact name, and its copy was not faithful: no BeautyOutdoors, no Plants category, harvest work 250 instead of 200. Two abstract defs may share a Name without any error - RimWorld resolves each parent reference to the copy from the highest-loading mod at or below the def asking for it - and that is precisely what makes redeclaring a vanilla name dangerous rather than merely untidy: so every plant of every mod could quietly have been reparented onto Fullzoon's copy. It also redefined CookMealBase, the base of every cooking recipe, from 1.0 - so missing the Anomaly exclusion of twisted meat. Neither copy was needed. Both are gone; the wheat inherits the real PlantBase and keeps its own harvest work of 250.
A sixth thought, AteFZfoods, was worth +99 mood for a day. Nothing referenced it, so it never fired. Dropped rather than carried forward.
The egg biscuit asked for chicken eggs by name, which locked out the six other vanilla eggs and every modded bird. It takes the unfertilised egg category now.
RUNS ALONGSIDE VANILLA-LIKE WHEAT
Mlie's Vanilla-like Wheat (Continued) grows wheat too. Nothing collides - the defNames differ - but two entries called "wheat plant" in one growing zone help nobody. Where that mod is loaded, this one stands down: its wheat leaves the sow menu, and the fifteen recipes take Mlie's wheat instead. They accept both. This mod's grain is labelled "wheat grain" rather than "wheat" for the same reason.
CREDIT AND REMOVAL
I am not the author of this mod. The wheat, the five biscuits, their recipes and their artwork are Fullzoon's - all I did was bring them to 1.6, fix what was broken, and write the English.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1623487558 - declares 1.0 and nothing since.
Fullzoon declared no licence anywhere - no file, no mention in the mod's own description. It is republished here under the usual convention for abandoned mods: full credit, a link to the original, and removal on request. If Fullzoon would rather this port did not exist, say so and it comes down - no argument, no delay.
The original has no packageId, so it cannot be declared incompatible. Do not run the two together: the defNames are the same and the game will complain about every one of them.
Content mod: removing it mid-save destroys any biscuits already baked and any wheat in the ground.
Source, changelog and attribution: https://github.com/vbardales/Rimworld-Fullzoon-Cookies-Renew
The port work was done with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic), under human direction and in-game testing. Thanks to Fullzoon for the biscuits.
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
